title: Warm Spicy Irish Sausage Skillet
description: A hearty and spicy Irish dish perfect for brunch, featuring little gem lettuce and salt-baked potatoes, high in protein and dense in flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toss the potatoes with salt and 1 tablespoon of oil, and spread on a baking sheet to roast for 20 minutes.
In a large skillet, cook the Irish sausage over medium-high heat, breaking into small pieces as it cooks, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and stir to deglaze, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Stir in the shredded cheddar cheese until melted and well combined.
Add the roasted potatoes and little gem lettuce to the skillet, stirring gently to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the mixture for 2-3 minutes, until the lettuce is slightly wilted.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
